messages:
sara: Heads-up — canary for the driver + CUDA push (535.86) on the h100 pool in us-west is failing. ~8/20 canary pods crash during kernel load with a PTX verification error. Repro on 2 canary hosts. @dilip can you take a look?

mike: logs? stack traces? any pattern (model, seq len, kernel)?

sara: quick paste of the most common error from the pod logs:
```
[2026-03-17T21:03:12Z] cuModuleLoadDataEx failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE (code -200)
ptx verifier: kernel signature mismatch: expected 0x1f2a3c, got 0x0
libcuda: cuModuleLoadData: ptx verification failed
```
sara: Also seeing NCCL timeouts on the same nodes shortly after, and a few persistent context OOM traces. Affected jobs are mostly SM90-optimized kernels.

dilip: thanks — that error smells like a PTX/toolchain mismatch. New driver added a stricter verifier for SM90 ptx blobs. If our compiled kernels include an older PTX format or missing embedded signature metadata they get rejected.

anna: we should stop the rollout and rollback canary immediately. If this hits dedicated pools in prod it could cause customer latency/failed requests.

mike: agree. block rollout and rollback canaries. tag the release.

deploy-bot: Rollout blocked by eng-infra @ 1867001242. Initiating rollback to driver 535.56 for canaries.

sara: rollback in progress. I'll keep this thread updated with counts and node IDs.

mike: short-term mitigation: can we set the runtime env REDWOOD_NVPTX_STRICT=0 on affected nodes to bypass the verifier while we investigate? That could be risky but may reduce impact.

dilip: we can try that in staging, but bypassing verifier may lead to silent incorrect kernels. Better plan: reproduce with the same nvcc/llvm toolchain we used for builds and rebuild the kernel PTX with the latest nvcc targeting sm_90 and the driver's expected PTX version. Also test with cuobjdump to confirm ptx header signature.

anna: what about capacity/customer impact? any evictions or queued jobs?

sara: so far only canaries and a few low-priority batch jobs. no major dedicated customer evictions yet. If rollback completes cleanly we should be fine; if not, we may need to drain the canaries and divert traffic.

mike: open an infra ticket and a driver-team ticket, attach logs and node list. Can we also run a quick matrix: (driver 535.56 vs 535.86) x (nvcc 12.2 vs 13.0) x (sm_90 compiled) in staging?

dilip: will spin up a repro matrix. probable root cause: PTX version/signature enforcement in 535.86 vs older drivers. Hotfix options: 1) rebuild kernels with updated nvcc, 2) ship a small shim that translates/embeds signature, 3) rollback driver for prod until we have a rebuild.

deploy-bot: Rollback to 535.56 completed for canaries @ 1867001260. Health checks green on canary hosts.

sara: rollback confirmed, canaries healthy again. Collating full crash logs and will paste to the infra ticket.

anna: thanks. please prepare a short customer-facing note if we see any degradation tomorrow. Also schedule a quick call with driver team if reproducer is ready.

mike: ACTIONS:
- sara: attach logs + node IDs to infra ticket and mark priority P1 (owner: sara)
- dilip: reproduce in staging and test rebuild options (owner: dilip)
- anna: prepare standby customer comms if rollouts are rescheduled (owner: anna)
- mike: hold driver rollout until signoff from dilip (owner: mike)

sara: taking infra ticket now, will update within 2 hours. :thumbsup:
